name: Robes
overview: Scripture uses robes and garments as powerful symbols of honor, righteousness, and salvation. In Isaiah 61:10, God’s people are clothed with the ‘robe of righteousness,’ illustrating the transformative grace that covers sin and imparts joy. Zechariah 3:4 further emphasizes this by depicting the removal of filthy garments and the clothing of a clean change of raiment, signifying forgiveness and renewal. The parable in Matthew 22:11 highlights the necessity of being properly clothed to partake in the kingdom, underscoring the spiritual readiness required to stand before God.
